boundaries: This capability does not perform YouTube search, channel discovery, playlist discovery, network acquisition, media download, login, cookie use, proxying, CAPTCHA bypass or PO-token handling.

The public network-acquisition capability is defined only by the current toolkit-contract.json. At schema 3.0 it is public YouTube channel-corpus acquisition and rejects direct video, Short and playlist requests; this external-intake contract does not redefine that network capability.
Only supplied corpus packages with a consistent receipt, manifest, result ZIP SHA-256 and per-transcript RUN-SHA256 inventory are accepted.
Archive path traversal, symlinks, duplicate paths, unreasonable member counts and unreasonable uncompressed size are rejected before extraction.
A partial run can be accepted as evidence only when partial reasons are preserved; partial is never upgraded to success.
Validated transcript corpora remain evidence/discovery material. They never become project truth, Skill truth or memory truth automatically.
Promotion of a claim requires claim extraction, deduplication, current primary or official verification when the claim can change, exactly one content owner and owner acceptance.
Transcript text is not copied into the normalized intake receipt or candidate index; only traceable metadata and SHA-256 values are emitted.
